verdict.rationale: Casium's for-organizations offering positions it as an employer immigration program: one platform shows where every case stands, a live view of the entire program, and one source of truth for compliance, billing, and reporting across 90 countries. That is first-party multi-case management for a team. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the multi-case dashboard (filtering, bulk actions, reporting depth), any stated startup or scale-up program or pricing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, I can run visas for a growing team through one provider — multi-case management or a stated startup/scale-up program beyond single founder cases

citations.quote: Best-in-class attorneys file your visas, and one platform shows you exactly where every case stands.
Casium gives your team a dedicated attorney, software built for immigration, and a live view of your entire program.
One source of truth for compliance, billing, and reporting. You always know where things stand, who's impacted, and what's coming next.
We replace the spreadsheets, the back-and-forth between employees and legal, and the scattered email threads with one intelligent platform.
